cohort.selection: All supported trials in 2026-10-21 manual reassessment

questions: How much of each missing witness already exists in executed agent history?
How many cases recover real bug detection through at most five automatically assembled candidates?

phase1.design: Informed manual observation with two independent Codex reviews for every case
phase1.independence: Reviewers must not read each other's current-study records. Root adjudicates after both reports exist.
phase1.unit: Semantically independently controllable factor; distinguish input/context/check and actual source units.
phase1.focal_failure_selection: Each reviewer identifies the focal actual Verifier failure before inspecting historical provenance, records that choice and any ambiguity. Adjudication resolves distinct focal choices explicitly.
phase1.unknown: null provenance_class with audit_status=unresolved; never convert missing evidence to Absent
phase1.assemblies: Proposed compatibility/assembly stays proposed until executed. Already observed P/R evidence may be cited with exact receipts; it is not new automatic evidence.

phase2.start_gate: All 88 informed cases reviewed twice and adjudicated; phase1 records frozen with hashes.
generation_inputs: historical tests visible in that trajectory or patch
phase2.isolation: Fresh generator process in clean filesystem container. Only public bundle and generic algorithm mounted; no host repository, Docker socket, prior sessions, external retrieval tools.
phase2.generation_feedback: Generate and freeze ranked candidates before any hidden reference/verifier evaluation. No hidden feedback regeneration.
phase2.algorithm: Automatic extraction of historical Trigger/Context/Check fragments followed by semantic assembly; concrete implementation and prompt hashes frozen before real generation.
phase2.new_semantics: Allowed but itemized and reported separately from reuse-only candidates.
phase2.candidate_execution: Independent evaluator executes identical tests on delivered patch P and correct reference R. Two repeats for claimed detections. Compare original source units on final P/R.
phase2.positive: Target test reached; task-related assertion/expected behavior fails on P and passes on R; independently confirmed same task defect; production implementation unchanged.
phase2.error_handling: Record compilation, collection, zero-test, unavailable environment and timeouts separately from behavioral outcomes. Static contract failures require an independently justified type-level witness.
phase2.minimality: Ablate successful factors where feasible; report least observed assembly and local necessity, never global minimality.

stage_gates.accept: all 88 identities recorded; known examples and repeated tasks marked; keep unresolved cases in denominator
stage_gates.reject: limit census to old 14 context-repair successes

stage_gates.accept: call/result mapping, exact test versions, explicit execution state, actual test count; mark lost/elided evidence
stage_gates.reject: shell rc0 alone, code appearance, final-file inference, generated-but-unrun scripts

stage_gates.accept: specific target and reliable expected effect; behavioral/static/unresolved declared; focal failure frozen before provenance search
stage_gates.reject: global failed reward or compilation infrastructure failure interpreted as runtime effect

stage_gates.accept: one classification per semantic missing factor; exact source/reachability receipts; null+unresolved allowed; Absent only after adequate history search
stage_gates.reject: no keyword match treated as Absent; identical assert syntax treated as matching oracle

stage_gates.accept: binding/order/lifetime map, reused vs new semantics, joint-history check and selected-unit rerun controls; actual P/R validation when assembled
stage_gates.reject: old context-only input/assertion restrictions carried into new Trigger/Check study; claim global minimality from one success

stage_gates.accept: only allowed Agent-time Issue/Patch/Trajectory/tests; remove final_metrics/reward/posthoc labels; immutable algorithm hash and per-case candidate budget; inputs+read-access receipts
stage_gates.reject: fresh thread alone claimed as isolation; reference/verifier paths, raw Git history or previous analysis available to generator

stage_gates.accept: automatic discovered candidate order and original inputs preserved; P execution feedback only if preauthorized by protocol; freeze candidates before R/Verifier assessment
stage_gates.reject: handwritten case-specific repairs, second-stage human salvage, target-source hardcoding or adapting to evaluation outcomes

stage_gates.accept: candidate valid executed target; P FAIL / R PASS, trusted expected semantics, same selected bug verified, production hashes unchanged; repetitions as predeclared
stage_gates.reject: zero tests, collection/compile/tool errors as bug detections, wrong observation or unrelated failures

stage_gates.accept: factor-role census and exact/related/absent/unresolved counts over all 88; separately blind eligible/executed/valid-detection counts and small candidate budgets; trajectory+task counts
stage_gates.reject: stage1 existence used as stage2 algorithm capability; old 14 reused as new automatic successes

Q1: number of trajectories with at least one exact reusable factor
number with all required factors exact
number needing new factor or oracle
complete historical witness vs fragmented ingredients
distinct-task counts and marked known examples
Q2: number with independently confirmed PFAIL/RPASS bug detection

observation_clarifications.rule: Record all required Trigger/Context/Check factors, but count missing_factors only relative to the selected base unit. A factor already present in that base does not establish a missing-factor reuse success.

Exact Check includes the expected relationship on the relevant effect/object/phase. An existing equality helper alone is not an exact oracle. Composed expectations from executed rules are Related; record new external primitives and derived joint relations separately.

Separate a full asserted witness from a visibly wrong printed effect, and record the production version on which the historical unit ran. Existing full witnesses are reported as a rerun/recovery baseline, not as newly assembled fragmentation.

observation_clarifications.introduced_after: S002 full-table execution in this study
observation_clarifications.rule: Keep the full-table control failures. An exploratory assembly using a previously selected original row may establish row-level fragment compatibility/detection, with scope and timing explicit; never report it as whole-test restoration. The blind phase receives no manual row narrowing after hidden evaluation.
